text_block_list.text:
During training, while taking a break with 
Nice Nature—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that Urara running over there?

Haru Urara is running alongside the others 
in her line of sight. ...Though she seems 
to be lagging quite far behind the pack.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*... Made it to the goooaaal!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Good work.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Nature-chan!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Man, you're amazing. Running like that in 
the middle of such a stacked lineup."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? 'Cause running is so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I run with strong girls, it 
lights a fire in me to get even stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Watch me in the upcoming mock race, okay?! 
I'm definitely gonna take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! Keep at it, youngsters! 
We're about ready to call it a day!
choice_data_list: Huh? I'm still in the middle of—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself too hard just because 
you're young, okay? Well then, good work 
today~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Bye-byee♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: *sigh* So uncool...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I came out even though I hadn't 
finished all my training menus.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No... It's really trivial, and nothing 
more than an embarrassing story, you 
know?"
choice_data_list: Even so, I still want to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I, see.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You know, I used to think shining like the 
main character was a privilege reserved 
only for first place.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But earlier, Urara was shining so 
brightly... It's frustrating to admit, but 
I thought she looked really cool.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I kinda feel like... all my escape routes 
have been cut off.
choice_data_list: If anything, a new path has opened up.

If you need an escape route, I'll prepare 
one for you.

If you need an escape route, I'll prepare 
one for you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I kinda feel like... all my escape routes 
have been cut off.
choice_data_list: If anything, a new path has opened up.

If you need an escape route, I'll prepare 
one for you.

If you need an escape route, I'll prepare 
one for you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whaddya mean?

There's no need to obsess over being in 
1st place. When I tell her that she can be 
the protagonist anytimeâ

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, Trainer... You're as 
relentlessly positive as ever, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That is hardly a line suited for a mere 
side character like myself.
choice_data_list:
To me, Nice Nature is always the 
protagonist—

To me, Nice Nature will always be the 
protagonist—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez, alright, I get it! So that's how 
it is in your head, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Your face is red, are you alright?
Your face is red, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever heard of having some tact? Even 
if you're thinking it, you don't just say 
it out loud!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief. You really are hopeless.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you done with training?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?

When things get tough, just lean on me. 
When times are hard, we'll stop and catch 
our breath together—
choice_data_list: That's what your Trainer is for!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
J-Jeez, what's that supposed to be? 
Showing off how reliable of an adult you 
are?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez, and here you actually made me think 
you looked a little cool for a second.
choice_data_list: That's truly how I feel, though...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well then, I suppose I'll take full 
advantage of your pampering right away.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
A heartbroken Nature-san seems to be 
craving takoyaki from the shopping 
district, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainer-san, you're a man 
who knows what's what~♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainer-san, you're a woman 
who knows what's what~♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you done with training?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It was super fun!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I see. Well, that's what matters 
most.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Nei-chan looks like she's having fun too! 
All humming and happy-go-lucky♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-You think so?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well, maybe it's thanks to a certain 
busybody.
